name: crab-crew
description: Follow your subagents at a glance: a status strip over the input box and a /crew panel where every subagent is a costumed pixel crab, with its model, steps, context, cost and runtime.

autoOpen.title: Crew panel auto-open
autoOpen.description: session: open once per session, at the first subagent or plan; flow: open at every new flow; off: open only with /crew or the strip's count

stepReports.title: Step reports from subagents
stepReports.description: on: built-in subagent briefs get one extra line asking for step calls, which drive their bars; off: briefs stay as written and bars show context use

glyphs.title: Glyph set
glyphs.description: nerd: Nerd Font pill caps and chevrons plus an octant crab on the strip; plain: half blocks, triangles and an ASCII crab for fonts lacking those
